live_lineage_r110.claim_boundary: This moves C4 from fixture-only to live in-scope smoke evidence. It covers and joins 182/318 raw effects (57.233% raw coverage) and joins 182/182 in-scope effects. method.native_export: collector report export after sqlite observed-agent envelope projection
method.scope: all process/file/network effects in exported snapshots
method.important_boundary: The collector export now emits session/tool envelope rows from observed local prompts and root process events. The envelope is export-derived, not yet persisted as first-class DB capture state.

native_lineage_r111.claim_boundary: R111 moves the R110 harness envelope into native collector report export. It still supports only a partial C4 claim: 182/318 raw effects joined (57.233%), with 136 orphan effects and export-derived rather than DB-persisted session/tool envelope rows.

method.snapshot_source: copies of three real AgentSight SQLite DB exports
method.materialization: collector report materialize-observed writes sessions/tool_calls to SQLite copies
method.export: collector report export --no-observed-projection reads persisted DB rows only
method.important_boundary: This proves DB-persisted backfill rows, not live capture-time first-class instrumentation; raw join remains partial.

db_lineage_r112.claim_boundary: R112 persists the R111 observed agent-run envelope into SQLite sessions/tool_calls tables and verifies persisted-only export. It still supports only a partial C4 claim: raw join remains 182/318 (57.233%), with 136 orphan effects and backfill-derived rather than capture-time session/tool ancestry.

live_record_r113.artifact_boundary: Raw SQLite DBs and exported snapshots stay in the local work dir and are not committed; rerun this harness to reproduce per-event evidence.
